dockerfile
# Use a standard Ubuntu 22.04 base image suitable for CPU builds
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set non-interactive frontend for package management to avoid prompts
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, compilers, version control, MPI, and certificates.
# Do not purge any packages as per instructions.
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    build-essential \
    g++ \
    gfortran \
    git \
    wget \
    ca-certificates \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set a temporary directory for building all source code
WORKDIR /opt/build

# Download, build, and install hypre from source
# Per requirements: version 2.28.0, Fortran disabled, bigint enabled.
RUN wget https://github.com/hypre-space/hypre/archive/refs/tags/v2.28.0.tar.gz -O hypre-v2.28.0.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzf hypre-v2.28.0.tar.gz && \
    cd hypre-2.28.0/src && \
    ./configure --disable-fortran --enable-bigint && \
    make -j$(nproc) && \
    make install

# Download, build, and install metis from source
# Per requirements: version 4.0.3 from the specified URL with specific OPTFLAGS.
# This version of Metis does not have a 'make install' target, so we manually copy the library and header.
RUN wget https://github.com/mfem/tpls/raw/gh-pages/metis-4.0.3.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzf metis-4.0.3.tar.gz && \
    cd metis-4.0.3 && \
    make -j$(nproc) OPTFLAGS="-Wno-error=implicit-function-declaration" && \
    cp libmetis.a /usr/local/lib/ && \
    cp metis.h /usr/local/include/

# Download, build, and install mfem from source
# Per requirements: version 4.7, built in parallel mode with MPI, linking against our custom hypre and metis.
RUN git clone https://github.com/mfem/mfem.git && \
    cd mfem && \
    git checkout v4.7 && \
    make parallel -j$(nproc) MFEM_USE_MPI=YES HYPRE_DIR=/usr/local METIS_DIR=/usr/local && \
    make install

# Download and build the laghos application, linking against our custom mfem build.
RUN git clone https://github.com/CEED/Laghos.git && \
    cd Laghos && \
    make -j$(nproc) MFEM_DIR=/usr/local

# Set the final runtime working directory
WORKDIR /app

# Copy the compiled laghos executable to a system path.
# Copy all data files from the laghos source into the runtime working directory.
RUN cp /opt/build/Laghos/laghos /usr/local/bin/laghos && \
    cp /opt/build/Laghos/data/* /app/

# Clean up the build directory to reduce final image size
RUN rm -rf /opt/build

# Configure Open MPI environment variables for compatibility and performance in containerized environments.
# This allows running as root and tunes behavior for typical cloud/container network setups.
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=^openib
ENV OMPI_MCA_pml=ob1

# Use a standard Ubuntu 22.04 base image suitable for CPU builds
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set non-interactive frontend for package management to avoid prompts
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, compilers, version control, MPI, and certificates.
# Do not purge any packages as per instructions.
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    build-essential \
    g++ \
    gfortran \
    git \
    wget \
    ca-certificates \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set a temporary directory for building all source code
WORKDIR /opt/build

# Download, build, and install hypre from source
# Per requirements: version 2.28.0, Fortran disabled, bigint enabled.
RUN wget https://github.com/hypre-space/hypre/archive/refs/tags/v2.28.0.tar.gz -O hypre-v2.28.0.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzf hypre-v2.28.0.tar.gz && \
    cd hypre-2.28.0/src && \
    ./configure --disable-fortran --enable-bigint && \
    make -j$(nproc) && \
    make install

# Download, build, and install metis from source
# Per requirements: version 4.0.3 from the specified URL with specific OPTFLAGS.
# This version of Metis does not have a 'make install' target, so we manually copy the library and header.
# FIX: Corrected path to metis.h which is located in the Lib/ subdirectory.
RUN wget https://github.com/mfem/tpls/raw/gh-pages/metis-4.0.3.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzf metis-4.0.3.tar.gz && \
    cd metis-4.0.3 && \
    make -j$(nproc) OPTFLAGS="-Wno-error=implicit-function-declaration" && \
    cp libmetis.a /usr/local/lib/ && \
    cp Lib/metis.h /usr/local/include/

# Download, build, and install mfem from source
# Per requirements: version 4.7, built in parallel mode with MPI, linking against our custom hypre and metis.
RUN git clone https://github.com/mfem/mfem.git && \
    cd mfem && \
    git checkout v4.7 && \
    make parallel -j$(nproc) MFEM_USE_MPI=YES HYPRE_DIR=/usr/local METIS_DIR=/usr/local && \
    make install

# Download and build the laghos application, linking against our custom mfem build.
RUN git clone https://github.com/CEED/Laghos.git && \
    cd Laghos && \
    make -j$(nproc) MFEM_DIR=/usr/local

# Set the final runtime working directory
WORKDIR /app

# Copy the compiled laghos executable to a system path.
# Copy all data files from the laghos source into the runtime working directory.
RUN cp /opt/build/Laghos/laghos /usr/local/bin/laghos && \
    cp /opt/build/Laghos/data/* /app/

# Clean up the build directory to reduce final image size
RUN rm -rf /opt/build

# Configure Open MPI environment variables for compatibility and performance in containerized environments.
# This allows running as root and tunes behavior for typical cloud/container network setups.
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=^openib
ENV OMPI_MCA_pml=ob1

# Use a standard Ubuntu 22.04 base image suitable for CPU builds
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set non-interactive frontend for package management to avoid prompts
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, compilers, version control, MPI, and certificates.
# Do not purge any packages as per instructions.
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    build-essential \
    g++ \
    gfortran \
    git \
    wget \
    ca-certificates \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set a temporary directory for building all source code
WORKDIR /opt/build

# Download, build, and install hypre from source
# Per requirements: version 2.28.0, Fortran disabled, bigint enabled.
# FIX: Manually copy the HYPRE_config.h header which is not installed by 'make install'.
RUN wget https://github.com/hypre-space/hypre/archive/refs/tags/v2.28.0.tar.gz -O hypre-v2.28.0.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzf hypre-v2.28.0.tar.gz && \
    cd hypre-2.28.0/src && \
    ./configure --disable-fortran --enable-bigint && \
    make -j$(nproc) && \
    make install && \
    cp HYPRE_config.h /usr/local/include/

# Download, build, and install metis from source
# Per requirements: version 4.0.3 from the specified URL with specific OPTFLAGS.
# This version of Metis does not have a 'make install' target, so we manually copy the library and header.
RUN wget https://github.com/mfem/tpls/raw/gh-pages/metis-4.0.3.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzf metis-4.0.3.tar.gz && \
    cd metis-4.0.3 && \
    make -j$(nproc) OPTFLAGS="-Wno-error=implicit-function-declaration" && \
    cp libmetis.a /usr/local/lib/ && \
    cp Lib/metis.h /usr/local/include/

# Download, build, and install mfem from source
# Per requirements: version 4.7, built in parallel mode with MPI, linking against our custom hypre and metis.
RUN git clone https://github.com/mfem/mfem.git && \
    cd mfem && \
    git checkout v4.7 && \
    make parallel -j$(nproc) MFEM_USE_MPI=YES HYPRE_DIR=/usr/local METIS_DIR=/usr/local && \
    make install

# Download and build the laghos application, linking against our custom mfem build.
RUN git clone https://github.com/CEED/Laghos.git && \
    cd Laghos && \
    make -j$(nproc) MFEM_DIR=/usr/local

# Set the final runtime working directory
WORKDIR /app

# Copy the compiled laghos executable to a system path.
# Copy all data files from the laghos source into the runtime working directory.
RUN cp /opt/build/Laghos/laghos /usr/local/bin/laghos && \
    cp /opt/build/Laghos/data/* /app/

# Clean up the build directory to reduce final image size
RUN rm -rf /opt/build

# Configure Open MPI environment variables for compatibility and performance in containerized environments.
# This allows running as root and tunes behavior for typical cloud/container network setups.
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=^openib
ENV OMPI_MCA_pml=ob1

# Use a standard Ubuntu 22.04 base image suitable for CPU builds
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set non-interactive frontend for package management to avoid prompts
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, compilers, version control, MPI, and certificates.
# Do not purge any packages as per instructions.
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    build-essential \
    g++ \
    gfortran \
    git \
    wget \
    ca-certificates \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set a temporary directory for building all source code
WORKDIR /opt/build

# Download, build, and install hypre from source
# Per requirements: version 2.28.0, Fortran disabled, bigint enabled.
# Manually copy all HYPRE headers which are not installed by 'make install'.
RUN wget https://github.com/hypre-space/hypre/archive/refs/tags/v2.28.0.tar.gz -O hypre-v2.28.0.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzf hypre-v2.28.0.tar.gz && \
    cd hypre-2.28.0/src && \
    ./configure --disable-fortran --enable-bigint && \
    make -j$(nproc) && \
    make install && \
    cp HYPRE_config.h /usr/local/include/ && \
    cp hypre/include/*.h /usr/local/include/

# Download, build, and install metis from source
# Per requirements: version 4.0.3 from the specified URL with specific OPTFLAGS.
# This version of Metis does not have a 'make install' target, so we manually copy the library and header.
RUN wget https://github.com/mfem/tpls/raw/gh-pages/metis-4.0.3.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzf metis-4.0.3.tar.gz && \
    cd metis-4.0.3 && \
    make -j$(nproc) OPTFLAGS="-Wno-error=implicit-function-declaration" && \
    cp libmetis.a /usr/local/lib/ && \
    cp Lib/metis.h /usr/local/include/

# Download, build, and install mfem from source
# Per requirements: version 4.7, built in parallel mode with MPI, linking against our custom hypre and metis.
# FIX: Explicitly set the installation PREFIX to ensure mfem is installed to a system path for the Laghos build.
RUN git clone https://github.com/mfem/mfem.git && \
    cd mfem && \
    git checkout v4.7 && \
    make parallel -j$(nproc) MFEM_USE_MPI=YES HYPRE_DIR=/usr/local METIS_DIR=/usr/local && \
    make install PREFIX=/usr/local

# Download and build the laghos application, linking against our custom mfem build.
RUN git clone https://github.com/CEED/Laghos.git && \
    cd Laghos && \
    make -j$(nproc) MFEM_DIR=/usr/local

# Set the final runtime working directory
WORKDIR /app

# Copy the compiled laghos executable to a system path.
# Copy all data files from the laghos source into the runtime working directory.
RUN cp /opt/build/Laghos/laghos /usr/local/bin/laghos && \
    cp /opt/build/Laghos/data/* /app/

# Clean up the build directory to reduce final image size
RUN rm -rf /opt/build

# Configure Open MPI environment variables for compatibility and performance in containerized environments.
# This allows running as root and tunes behavior for typical cloud/container network setups.
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=^openib
ENV OMPI_MCA_pml=ob1

# Use a standard Ubuntu 22.04 base image suitable for CPU builds
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set non-interactive frontend for package management to avoid prompts
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, compilers, version control, MPI, and certificates.
# Do not purge any packages as per instructions.
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    build-essential \
    g++ \
    gfortran \
    git \
    wget \
    ca-certificates \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set a temporary directory for building all source code
WORKDIR /opt/build

# Download, build, and install hypre from source
# Per requirements: version 2.28.0, Fortran disabled, bigint enabled.
# FIX: Use an in-source build with an explicit --prefix to ensure libraries and headers
# are installed correctly to standard system paths, resolving previous linker errors.
RUN wget https://github.com/hypre-space/hypre/archive/refs/tags/v2.28.0.tar.gz -O hypre-v2.28.0.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzf hypre-v2.28.0.tar.gz && \
    cd hypre-2.28.0/src && \
    ./configure --prefix=/usr/local --disable-fortran --enable-bigint && \
    make -j$(nproc) && \
    make install

# Download, build, and install metis from source
# Per requirements: version 4.0.3 from the specified URL with specific OPTFLAGS.
# This version of Metis does not have a 'make install' target, so we manually copy the library and header.
RUN wget https://github.com/mfem/tpls/raw/gh-pages/metis-4.0.3.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzf metis-4.0.3.tar.gz && \
    cd metis-4.0.3 && \
    make -j$(nproc) OPTFLAGS="-Wno-error=implicit-function-declaration" && \
    cp libmetis.a /usr/local/lib/ && \
    cp Lib/metis.h /usr/local/include/

# Download, build, and install mfem from source
# Per requirements: version 4.7, built in parallel mode with MPI, linking against our custom hypre and metis.
# Explicitly set the installation PREFIX to ensure mfem is installed to a system path for the Laghos build.
RUN git clone https://github.com/mfem/mfem.git && \
    cd mfem && \
    git checkout v4.7 && \
    make parallel -j$(nproc) MFEM_USE_MPI=YES HYPRE_DIR=/usr/local METIS_DIR=/usr/local && \
    make install PREFIX=/usr/local

# Download and build the laghos application, linking against our custom mfem build.
RUN git clone https://github.com/CEED/Laghos.git && \
    cd Laghos && \
    make -j$(nproc) MFEM_DIR=/usr/local

# Set the final runtime working directory
WORKDIR /app

# Copy the compiled laghos executable to a system path.
# Copy all data files from the laghos source into the runtime working directory.
RUN cp /opt/build/Laghos/laghos /usr/local/bin/laghos && \
    cp /opt/build/Laghos/data/* /app/

# Clean up the build directory to reduce final image size
RUN rm -rf /opt/build

# Configure Open MPI environment variables for compatibility and performance in containerized environments.
# This allows running as root and tunes behavior for typical cloud/container network setups.
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=^openib
ENV OMPI_MCA_pml=ob1

flux-minicluster-manifest
#
# MiniCluster Manifest for a Laghos HPC experiment
#
# Persona: Kubernetes Flux Framework MiniCluster expert
# Environment: AWS CPU instance in Kubernetes
# Application: Laghos (Lagrangian High-Order Solver)
#
# This manifest is optimized for performance by scheduling the job on a
# powerful ARM-based instance and utilizing all its cores. This addresses
# the timeout failure from the previous attempt.
#
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # A unique name for the MiniCluster job instance.
  name: laghos-cpu-experiment
  # Deploying to the default namespace as requested.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The size of the cluster in pods. The job will run on a single powerful node.
  size: 1

  # FIX: Increased tasks to 64 to match the vCPU count of the selected
  # c7g.16xlarge instance, maximizing parallelism and performance.
  tasks: 64

  # Do not delete pods and services upon job completion to allow for inspection.
  cleanup: false

  # Enable strict schema validation for the MiniCluster spec.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # FIX: Specify the ARM-compatible Flux container image, which is required
  # when running on AWS Graviton (ARM64) instances.
  flux:
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # FIX: Add pod specification to control scheduling.
  pod:
    # Schedule the pod on a c7g.16xlarge instance, which provides
    # 64 ARM-based vCPUs, to ensure sufficient computational power.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: c7g.16xlarge

  # Specification for the application container.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:laghos
      
      # This is the main application container, not a launcher pod.
      launcher: false

      # The working directory is /app, where the application and data files are located.
      workingDir: /app

      # The command remains unchanged as we are scaling hardware, not the problem itself.
      command: laghos -p 1 -m cube_311_hex.mesh -rs 3 -tf 0.75

Decision 3: STOP

Agent's Rationale: The second attempt, utilizing the HPC-optimized Graviton3 instance (hpc7g.16xlarge) with 64 tasks and the partial assembly flag (-pa), achieved the highest performance score. A subsequent trial on a high-performance AMD instance resulted in a significant performance drop, indicating that the combination of the Graviton3 architecture and higher core count is optimal for this workload among the available options. Further attempts are unlikely to yield substantial gains.
